episodes.synopsis: Reigning class gambling champion Mary attempts to hustle unsuspecting transfer student Yumeko Jabami into a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors.
episodes.title: The Woman Called Yumeko Jabami

episodes.synopsis: Mary is relegated to the lowest levels of the gambling hierarchy after her loss. Student board member Itsuki challenges Yumeko to a game of pairs.
episodes.title: The Boring Woman

episodes.synopsis: To regain her status, Mary duels student board member Yuriko in a game of "life or death." With Mary's crushing defeat, Yumeko offers to play next.
episodes.title: Slit-Eyed Woman

episodes.synopsis: Yumeko and Mary square off against two others in a game of Indian poker after being given a chance to minimize their colossal gambling debts.
episodes.title: The Woman Who Became Livestock

episodes.synopsis: Kiwatari continues to lose as Yumeko and Mary bluff their way through the game, but the final outcome all comes down to Tsubomi.
episodes.title: The Woman Who Became Human

episodes.synopsis: Yumeko must face Beautification Committee Chair Midari in an ESP card game involving Russian roulette before playing the student board president.
episodes.title: Tempting Woman

episodes.synopsis: Deeply engaged in their deadly ESP card game, Midari tells Yumeko about her heated match against student board president, Kirari.
episodes.title: Refusing Women

episodes.synopsis: In Kirari's absence, pop idol sensation Yumemi offers to play against Yumeko, asking her to wager total control of her life.
episodes.title: Love-Dancing Woman

episodes.synopsis: With her pop idol career on the line, an enraged Yumemi seeks to ruin Yumeko after a scandalous voice recording is used as a bargaining chip.
episodes.title: Dreaming Woman

episodes.synopsis: Yumeko's odds are stacked against her when she challenges the well-funded student board treasurer, Manyuda, in an original game of poker.
episodes.title: Selective Woman

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki, no longer wanting to be under Manyuda's control, offers to bankroll 100 chips after Yumeko goes all-in and loses on the previous hand.
episodes.title: The Woman Who Bets Her Life

episodes.synopsis: Yumeko and student board president Kirari both wager self-expulsion from the academy as Ryota becomes the key to the final outcome of their game.
episodes.title: Gambling Woman
